readout_other: real-time place preference test; open field test; rat exposure test (freezing); H&E and Nissl staining
direction_notes: LIFUS of the PAG produced place avoidance in the rtPPT, increased high-speed movement (flight) in the open field without anxiety-like changes, and increased freezing in the rat exposure test during ON periods.
safety_notes: H&E and Nissl staining showed no tissue damage or hemorrhage; calculated temperature rise 0.002 C.

exposures.label: LIFUS of PAG, head-mounted 3.8 MHz transducer

timing.protocol_description: TBD 0.5 ms, PRF 1000 Hz, DC 50%; ultrasound delivered into the PAG each time the mouse crossed to the stimulation side (rtPPT), continuously over a 20-min open field session, and in 1-min OFF / 1-min ON cycles in the rat exposure test (three cycles). NTB and ISI are set on the function generator but values are not given in the text.
